name: Custom Shape 5-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Piggy Bank
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood and clear acrylic, ensuring durability and a premium finish.
    - Features a 5-layer structure:
                     +) Layer 1, 2, 3, 4: Wooden 5mm thickness.
                     +) Layer 5 (Front Panel): Acrylic 2mm thickness.
    - Securely assembled using metal screws (length 5mm) for firm and stable construction.
    - Smooth laser-cut edges provide a clean, polished appearance.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in multiple designs and sizes:
                     +) 6 x 6 inches ~ 15.24 x 15.24 cm.
                     +) 8 x 8 inches ~ 20.32 x 20.32 cm.
                     +) 10 x 10 inches ~ 25.4 x 25.4 cm.
    - Includes max 10 screws, diameter of 6mm, length 5mm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Printed using advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting durability.
    - Double-sided printing applied to layer 1.
    - Single-sided printing applied to layers 2, 3, 4 and layer 5.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a reusable piggy bank to save money for goals, events, or special occasions.
    - Transparent acrylic front allows easy viewing of savings progress.
    - Can be used for wedding funds, anniversary savings, travel goals, baby funds, birthday savings, and more.
    - Suitable for display on desks, shelves, bedrooms, living rooms, or offices.
    📌 Note: Coins and money can be inserted from the top opening. The acrylic front can be removed by unscrewing it when needed.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful and personalized gift for couples, newlyweds, families, children, and friends.
    - Perfect for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, graduations, baby showers, and holidays.
    - A beautiful keepsake that combines décor and practical savings in one thoughtful piece.
     

 SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1xCustom Shape 5-Layer Wooden And Acrylic Piggy Bank

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.1-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.
    • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
